subject: Web Development
title: Promises and Async Await
description: A short lesson to help you apply Promises and Async Await.

hook.text: JavaScript handles async tasks with callbacks. Nesting them creates 'callback hell.'

buildup.text: Promises wrapped async results in objects you could chain with .then() instead of nesting.

discovery.text: Async/await in 2017 made async code look like regular synchronous code.

twist.text: Under the hood, nothing changed. Async/await is just syntactic sugar over promises.

climax.text: The syntax shift made JavaScript's async model accessible to developers of all skill levels.
